action: Opens the Shift+S snap pie and sets the 3D cursor to world origin before adding the hair object.
tool: Snap pie (Shift+S) > Cursor to World Origin
why: New hair object gets its origin at world centre.

action: In a new empty mesh object Cube.007 (Verts 0/0, no modifiers), in see-through front view, extrudes a vertex chain from the crown along the hairline and rotates it.
view: Front Orthographic, Edit Mode, see-through over reference
why: Trace the fringe outline first.
reader_equivalent: create verts along the hairline in bmesh and extrude edges into faces

action: Adjusts in side view, undoes a move, and Ctrl-click extrudes to cursor.
tool: Move (G x2), Undo, Extrude to Cursor
why: Place the hair strip a little off the scalp.
reader_equivalent: set vertex coords from side reference

action: With X-ray off, moves strip vertices so the first quad sits over the scalp above the forehead.
view: Front Orthographic and User Orthographic, solid
why: Keep the hair shell above the skull surface.
reader_equivalent: offset hair verts outward along the head normal

action: Builds a single-row band of quads across the top of the head following the hairline from centre to temple.
why: A fringe band to hang bang strands from.
reader_equivalent: extrude the band edge-by-edge along the hairline

action: Selects an edge of the band and moves/scales it down beside the face to start a side bang.
why: Taper the strand toward the tip.
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.scale on the tip edge verts

action: Extrudes the band edge downward into a bang strand that hangs in front of the ear.
why: Each bang is a one-face-wide strip extruded down.

action: Adds a loop cut across the strand and fills a face (F) to keep it quads, then checks it in side view.
tool: Loop Cut and Slide (Ctrl+R), Make Face (F)
view: Front Orthographic see-through, then Right Orthographic
why: More rows to bend the strand.

action: In side view pulls a long strand down past the jaw and curves it, as a single strip of quads with open edges (no thickness).
why: Long side lock framing the face.
reader_equivalent: extrude edge repeatedly along a curve of points

action: Switches the left image editor to a close front portrait of the character and moves strand vertices to it in see-through front view.
why: Read hair shapes from a larger reference.
reader_equivalent: load a second reference image (bpy.data.images.load) for comparison

action: Extrudes the bang band several times down the side of the face to form more strands.
why: Add strands to the fringe.

action: Moves strand vertices with Proportional Editing on (large circle) in side view, then rips a vertex (V) to split strands.
why: Bend strands smoothly; separate neighbouring strands.

action: Tries another rip (status shows 'Rip failed') and adjusts the strand next to the ear.
why: Separate strand tips.

action: Selects one side strand with Select Linked and opens Add Modifier; next frame shows a new object Cube.008 with a Mirror modifier (X, Clipping, Merge 0.001 m) next to Cube.007.
tool: Select Linked (L), Separate (inferred), Add Modifier > Mirror
view: Front Orthographic Edit Mode, then User Orthographic Object Mode
why: Symmetric hair goes in a mirrored object; the asymmetric fringe stays in Cube.007.

action: Adds a UV Sphere (146 verts, 160 faces) and moves it up to head height in Edit Mode.
why: A sphere gives the round skull cap of the hair.

action: Fits the sphere to the head in side view, deletes part of it (X), and the cap becomes part of Cube.008 (mirrored), shaped with proportional editing.
view: Right Orthographic, Front Orthographic, User Orthographic
why: Skull cap under the strands so no scalp shows.
reader_equivalent: delete faces with x<0 and the lower rings; join into hair object; bpy.ops.object.join()

action: Cube.008 (mirrored half cap with the side lock) is 69 verts / 46 faces; shapes its edge around the ear.
why: Low-poly cap matching the head.

action: Returns to Cube.007 (fringe) and adjusts strands from Front, Top and Left Orthographic so they wrap the cap.
view: Front, Top and Left Orthographic, solid
why: Check strands from all axes.
reader_equivalent: translate verts; render views from each axis

action: Moves a strand on the side of the head and then, from top view, picks a small new piece with Select Linked at the crown.
why: Start the hair bun on top.

action: Duplicates the small piece and rotates the copy around the view Z axis at the crown.
why: Radial petals form the bun.

action: Adds a loop cut to a bun petal and shapes petals by moving vertices.
why: Give petals a bend.

action: Rotates more duplicated petals around Z in top view until they ring the crown.
why: Close the bun.
reader_equivalent: loop: duplicate petal, rotate about crown Z

action: On Cube.008 duplicates geometry (Shift+D) and uses the view pie to switch views.
why: Reuse strand shapes.

action: Extrudes a strip from the cap down behind the ear and bends it with Proportional Editing.
tool: Extrude Region and Move, Move with Proportional Editing
why: Side lock behind the ear, mirrored to both sides.

action: Adds a loop cut along the side lock and moves its vertices to the reference.
why: Extra rows to curve the lock.

action: Moves the lock tip in see-through front view onto the drawn hair outline.
why: Fit silhouette in front view.

action: Duplicates one back strand and rotates the copy around Z in top view to place the next strand around the back of the head.
why: Back hair is a ring of similar strips around the head.
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.duplicate + bmesh.ops.rotate about Z through head centre by -31.3 deg

action: Scales the strand tip vertices toward a point and moves it.
why: Pointed strand tips.
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.scale on tip verts about their centre

action: Selects strands with Select Linked (L, Shift to add) and fills the back of the head with more rotated copies; the back reads as a ring of strips.
why: Cover the back of the skull.

action: Circle-selects (C) vertices in see-through front view to refine the side hair; Mirror Clipping on Cube.008 is now off.
why: Strands near the centre line must be free to cross it.

action: Extrudes a strand tip and rotates it in see-through front view so it flicks outward.
why: Outward flicks at the bob's ends.

action: Back hair now a full bob of vertical strips; selects one strip with Select Linked, duplicates it and it appears as a new object Cube.009 (18 verts, 10 faces, no modifier).
why: Build an extra over-layer strand separately.

action: Scales and loop-cuts the Cube.009 strand in back and side views.
tool: Scale, Loop Cut and Slide, Move
why: Fit the extra strand on top of the back hair.

action: Leaves Cube.009 and undoes several steps (Ctrl+Z x4) on Cube.008; the bob outline of Cube.008 is shown selected.
why: Revert an unwanted change.

action: Uses the shading pie (Z) on Cube.008; object count is back to 11 (Cube.009 no longer counted).
why: Toggle wireframe/solid to inspect.

action: Duplicates a strand next to the ear and rotates it to add a layered strand in front of the side hair.
why: Layering gives depth to the side hair.

action: Grows a face selection along a strand with Select More (Ctrl+Numpad+ x3, Face Step on).
why: Select the strand to edit.

action: Extrudes the strand end edge and scales it down to a point to make a spiky tip sticking back.
why: Spiky tips from the reference.
reader_equivalent: extrude tip edge, translate, bmesh.ops.scale to near zero

action: Moves tip vertices in back view and 3/4 view to finish the bob ends.
why: Silhouette tuning.

action: Back on the body mesh Cube, uses the Knife to cut new edges on the torso front.
why: Body detail cleanup (not hair).

action: Outliner now shows the Model collection as three objects: Body (with Mirror), Hair1, Hair2.
why: Clean, named parts for rigging and export.
reader_equivalent: join body parts; obj.name = 'Body'; hair objects renamed 'Hair1', 'Hair2'
